```{r data-Adjustment}

#making the data in long format, 
#centre is the name of the centre
#outcome is pass for initial pass and fail for initial fail
#count is the year 2024's count for each centre
initial_longer <- cartest |>
  transmute(
    centre = as.character(Test.Centre),
    outcome = recode(as.character(Statistic),
      "Pass: Initial Test" = "pass",#make sure to mention taht pass / fail are the initial pass fail 
      "Fail: Initial Test" = "fail",
      .default = NA_character_
    ),
    count = `2024`
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(outcome))

#making it wider and adding a total column 
initial_wider <- initial_longer |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = outcome, 
    values_from = count
    ) |>
  mutate(total = pass + fail) 

#removing the sum count for the graph later / and dropping the NA which is Northpoint initial_wider |> filter(is.na(pass)|is.na(fail)) how i confirmed it was the only one
  
initial_wider <- initial_wider |>
  filter(centre !="All test results") |>
  drop_na(centre,pass,fail)

#sum of pass, fail, total tests, to find the national average passing rate
pass_national <- sum(initial_wider$pass)
fail_national <- sum(initial_wider$fail)
total_tests_national<- sum(initial_wider$total)
national_mean <- 100 * pass_national/total_tests_national 

#Save which Centre is in which county source https://www.ncts.ie/locations/
centre_counties <- tribble(
  ~centre, ~county,
  "Abbeyfeale", "Limerick",
  "Arklow", "Wicklow",
  "Athlone", "Westmeath",
  "Ballina", "Mayo",
  "Ballinasloe", "Galway",
  "Cahir", "Tipperary",
  "Cahirciveen", "Kerry",
  "Carlow", "Carlow",
  "Carndonagh", "Donegal",
  "Carrick-on-Shannon", "Leitrim",
  "Castlerea", "Roscommon",
  "Castleisland", "Kerry",
  "Cavan", "Cavan",
  "Charleville", "Cork",
  "Clifden", "Galway",
  "Cork Blarney", "Cork",
  "Cork Little Island", "Cork",
  "Deansgrange", "Dublin",
  "Derrybeg", "Donegal",
  "Donegal", "Donegal",
  "Drogheda", "Louth",
  "Dundalk", "Louth",
  "Ennis", "Clare",
  "Enniscorthy", "Wexford",
  "Fonthill", "Dublin",
  "Galway", "Galway",
  "Greenhills", "Dublin",
  "Kells", "Meath",
  "Kilkenny", "Kilkenny",
  "Killarney", "Kerry",
  "Letterkenny", "Donegal",
  "Limerick", "Limerick",
  "Longford", "Longford",
  "Macroom", "Cork",
  "Monaghan", "Monaghan",
  "Mullingar", "Westmeath",
  "Naas", "Kildare",
  "Navan", "Meath",
  "Nenagh", "Tipperary",
  "Northpoint Ballymun 1", "Dublin",
  "Northpoint Ballymun 2", "Dublin",
  "Portlaoise", "Laois",
  "Skibbereen", "Cork",
  "Sligo", "Sligo",
  "Tralee", "Kerry",
  "Tuam", "Galway",
  "Tullamore", "Offaly",
  "Waterford", "Waterford",
  "Westport", "Mayo",
  "Youghal", "Cork"
)

#adds county to the wider dataset by matching centre
centre_tests <- initial_wider |> left_join(centre_counties, by = "centre")

county_rates <- centre_tests |>
  group_by(county) |>
  summarise(
    centres = n(),
    passes = sum(pass),
    totals = sum(total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pass_rate = 100 * passes / totals,
    precentage_difference = pass_rate - national_mean
  )

top3_counties <- county_rates|>slice_max(pass_rate,n=3)#top 3 countys
lowest_county <- county_rates|>slice_min(pass_rate,n=1)#find which is the worst
count_above_mean<-sum(county_rates$precentage_difference>0)#find above mean counties
```

```{r graph,fig.align='center',fig.width=8,fig.height=8}
#reading in the data 
ireland <- st_read("data/ie_county_26.json", quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_set_crs(NA) |>
  st_set_crs(29903) |>
  transmute(county = AREA_NAME)

#removes nothen ireland 
county_map<- ireland |> filter(county != "Nothern Ireland")

#adds county rates to the existing geo data 
county_map <- county_map |> left_join(county_rates , by="county")

#using the data to make labels for top 3
labels <- county_map |> 
  filter(county %in% top3_counties$county) |>
  mutate(county_label = paste0(county, "\n", round(pass_rate, 2), "%"))

#plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = county_map,
    aes(fill = pass_rate),
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  geom_sf_label(
    data = labels,
    aes(label = county_label), 
    fontface = "bold",
    size= 4,
    fill = scales::alpha("white",.6)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    name = "First-time pass rate",
    guide = guide_colourbar(
      barwidth = grid::unit(10, "cm"),
      barheight = grid::unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
  ) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "First-time NCT pass rates by county",
    subtitle = paste("2024 - National pass rate:", round(national_mean,2),"%"),
    caption = "Data: RSA (2024)  |  County Boundaries: CSO"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 19, hjust=1),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "gray30", hjust=0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(colour = "gray30",hjust=0.5, size=7),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 16, 10, 16)
  )
```
